predictions.reasoning: A sharp jump in the implied probability of Netanyahu leaving office would be the clearest channel into Israeli-exposed assets. The sign is genuinely ambiguous: markets at times treated political/judicial-overhaul turmoil under Netanyahu as a risk premium, so an orderly departure could reduce domestic political risk and lift equities; but an abrupt resignation/removal (coalition collapse, security crisis, indictment escalation) introduces governance uncertainty that could pressure them. A long-dated (end-2026) resolution question moving within a 12h window is unlikely to force a >700bps move in a diversified country ETF absent a concrete, imminent catalyst.

llm_justification.summary: The market tracks the probability that Netanyahu leaves office before end-2026. The cleanest public-market channels are Israeli equities (EIS) and the shekel (USD/ILS), but the sign of any reaction is ambiguous — a departure could be read as reducing political/judicial-overhaul risk (bullish) or introducing governance uncertainty (bearish). Given the long resolution horizon and the 12h window, expected moves are modest and well below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-confidence, non-tradable mapping best flagged as mixed/unclear.
